name: searchgres-workspace
description: Workspace root for searchgres. Not published.

scripts.build: npm run build --workspace=searchgres && npm run build --workspace=@searchgres/protocol && npm run build --workspace=@searchgres/client && npm run build --workspace=@searchgres/server && npm run build --workspace=@searchgres/cli
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck --workspace=searchgres && npm run build --workspace=searchgres && npm run build --workspace=@searchgres/protocol && npm run typecheck --workspace=@searchgres/protocol && npm run build --workspace=@searchgres/client && npm run typecheck --workspace=@searchgres/client && npm run typecheck --workspace=@searchgres/server && npm run build --workspace=@searchgres/server && npm run typecheck --workspace=@searchgres/cli
scripts.test:unit: npm run build --workspace=searchgres && npm run build --workspace=@searchgres/protocol && npm run test:unit --workspaces --if-present
scripts.test:db: npm run build && npm run test:db --workspaces --if-present
scripts.check: npm run typecheck && npm run lint && npm run test:unit
